title: Crusher hydraulic power pack, pump failure from contamination
tests: Forced deterioration (contamination); filter bypass; evidence in oil analysis; some no-evidence nodes.
summary: Hydraulic pump on a crusher setting-adjust power pack failed with scored pistons. Oil analysis showed particle counts well over the target and the return filter bypass indicator was popped for weeks. The tree is partly evidenced with two nodes unsupported.

problem.title: Hydraulic pump failure on crusher power pack HPU-02
problem.site: Hard rock quarry, Hunter Valley NSW
problem.whatHappened: The piston pump on HPU-02 lost pressure on 12 Aug 2026 and the crusher setting could not be adjusted. The pump was removed and the pistons and port plate were scored. The oil was dark with metal fines. The return filter bypass indicator had been popped for several weeks.
problem.where: Pump pistons, port plate, and return filter on HPU-02.
problem.when: Pressure loss over about 3 days; found at day shift.
problem.impact: Crusher out of service for 2 days, as tramp release could not be set. Pump replacement and a full oil change and flush.
problem.duty: Crusher setting adjust and tramp release, intermittent

evidence.title: Pump pistons and port plate
evidence.note: Axial scoring on 5 of 9 pistons; port plate scored and discoloured.

evidence.title: Oil analysis report
evidence.note: Particle count ISO 22/20/17. Silicon high. The site target is not set in the plan.

evidence.title: Return filter
evidence.note: Bypass indicator popped; element blocked with fines and dirt. Breather without a filter element.

evidence.title: Operator
evidence.note: Indicator seen red for weeks; no instruction about what to do.

capa.deteriorationReasoning: Contamination damaged the pistons and port plate. It is forced wear from dirty oil, not natural pump life.

preventive.what: Replace return filter element at a set interval and when the indicator goes red
preventive.interval: every 6 months or 1,000 hours run, check against the oil results

preventive.what: Oil sample for particle count and water against a stated cleanliness target
Response procedure for a filter bypass indicator with a time to act
Fit a filtered breather and a quick-fit filter cart connection
Hold a pump or an exchange unit, plus filter elements

capa.spares: Hydraulic pump exchange unit and filter elements; 25 day lead time on a critical power pack.
capa.rollout: All hydraulic power packs on crushers and conveyors: check breather, filter indicators and oil cleanliness.
